About Adaptive

Adaptive is a cybersecurity startup on a mission to stop AI-powered cyberattacks. In December 2025, the company announced an $81M Series B led by NVIDIA and Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Citi Ventures, and continued support from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the OpenAI Startup Fund, and Abstract Ventures. The round marked NVIDIA’s first AI cybersecurity investment.

Adaptive was founded by Brian Long and Andrew Jones, repeat entrepreneurs who have built and scaled category-defining companies. Brian and Andrew previously co-founded Attentive, which grew to more than $500M in annual revenue and a $10B+ valuation, and TapCommerce, which was acquired by Twitter. Together, they bring deep experience building high-growth, product-led businesses at massive scale as Adaptive builds the security layer for the AI era.

Trusted by leading banks, technology companies, and healthcare organizations, Adaptive protects teams from emerging threats like deepfakes, smishing, and AI-powered voice scams. With rapid enterprise adoption and a $200B+ market ahead, the company is just getting started.

The Role

We’re looking for a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to accelerate growth across the western and central North American region. In this high-impact role, you will own the development and success of channel relationships, both new and existing, while working closely with Sales and Marketing to drive pipeline generation and partner enablement.

You will focus on the top 10-12 partners in your territory and drive partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across all partners in the region. Reporting directly to the VP of Channel Sales, you will act as a strategic business partner to help ensure high growth and continued success for our partners and for Adaptive.

This is a remote role, with preference for candidates located near our main office hubs (LA or SF).

Territories: WA, OR, CA, NV, ID, MT, WY, UT, CO, AZ, NM, AK, HI, ND, SD, NE, KS, OK, TX, MN,

IA, MO, AR, LA, WI, IL, MI, IN, OH

Responsibilities

  • Build and grow relationships with the top 10-12 focus partners in the West and Central

    US, mapping their sellers to Adaptive's AEs.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won ARR against a quarterly target, with

    deal registrations, joint account planning and co-selling.

  • Work alongside Adaptive's AEs in the region so partners and AEs sell together.

  • Run partner enablement: train partner sellers and engineers on Security Awareness

    Training, Email Security and AI Governance.

  • Plan and attend partner events, lunch-and-learns and joint campaigns.

  • Manage the deal registration process for your partners and keep Salesforce and the

    partner portal current.

  • Work with our iCAM(s) on new-partner recruitment and long-tail support in the region.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in channel or partner sales in cybersecurity or enterprise software.

  • Established relationships with resellers and their sellers in the West and Central US. This matters most.

  • A track record of hitting partner-sourced revenue targets.

  • Comfort working with enterprise accounts and long, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Strong Salesforce habits and comfort with a partner portal (Impartner experience a

    plus).

  • Willingness to travel within the region for partner meetings and events (up to 50%).

What We Bring

  • Competitive cash compensation & OTE.

  • Several medical plans to choose from, most covered at 100% by Adaptive.

  • 401k through Vestwell

  • Unlimited PTO, including winter break from Dec 24 - Jan 1.

  • Exposure to leadership and getting in early at a growing Channel function

Ready to Apply?

If you are high-agency and competitive, motivated to help build a world-class company, we want to hear from you. Join us in our mission to outsmart AI-powered threats and protect organizations around the world.
